answer: Make every new agent identity post a slashable bond that unlocks only after it signs work peers can check. Picture a sybil farmer on a knoll launching a comet of 1,000 fake agents: each needs its own bond, so the attack costs 1,000x the stake, and when graders catch duplicate outputs, the quill that signed them burns every linked bond. Honest agents pay once; mass fakes pay linearly and lose it all.
